description:
Activate Skirge Familiar by discarding Clay Revenant, adding {B}.
Bone Miser's first ability triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Zombie, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Clay Revenant by paying {2}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
